outcome: prevalence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
neonatal intensive care unit admission rates
cohort: 2834 patients admitted between September 2017 and March 2018 with a diagnosis of any hypertensive disorder at Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University Medical Center in China
finding: Compared to a US hospital, Chinese women with hypertensive disorders had higher rates of antihypertensive drug administration and cesarean sections, while their infants had lower NICU admission rates; however, healthcare providers showed poor knowledge of preeclampsia guidelines.
mod_finding: Rates of cesarean section were higher in China compared to the US hospital.
